styles.name: steam-train
styles.description: Steam locomotive with cab, boiler, dome and flared stack pulls a tender and coach; connecting rods turn the wheels and smoke streams back

styles.name: airplane-takeoff
styles.description: Side-view airliner with swept wing, tail fin and window band taxis the runway, rotates nose-up and climbs out trailing a contrail; strobe lights and tail beacon blink

styles.name: sailboat-tacking
styles.description: Sloop with hull, mast, mainsail and jib sails right over rolling waves; the sails swing through each tack and the hull bobs

styles.name: subway-map
styles.description: Subway route line: station dots fill as the train marker advances between stops

styles.name: hot-air-balloon
styles.description: Teardrop hot-air balloon with gored envelope, rope-hung basket and flickering burner lifts off and drifts up and right past clouds

styles.name: ferris-wheel
styles.description: Big spoked Ferris wheel turns on an A-frame with cabins hanging level; festoon bulbs on the light strings switch on with progress

styles.name: cable-car
styles.description: Gondola climbs a diagonal cable from valley to peak; support towers mark intervals

styles.name: escalator
styles.description: Escalator between two floors: stepped truss and handrail with steps climbing over time; a rider walks on, rides up and steps off with progress

styles.name: rocket-gantry
styles.description: Rocket fuels beside its gantry, the arms swing clear, and it lifts off

styles.name: ferry-crossing
styles.description: Ferry with hull, two window decks and a funnel crosses between piers; a V wake opens behind, smoke streams back and waves roll

styles.name: bicycle
styles.description: Diamond-frame bicycle with saddle and handlebars rolls right on spoked wheels; spokes spin and the pedal crank turns

styles.name: helicopter
styles.description: Helicopter with bubble cabin, tail boom, tail rotor and skids lifts off a pad and climbs right; the main rotor sweeps and downwash kicks up
